NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author edited the PR description (now "Part of #16189", with a fixture explanation and a screenshot) but pushed no new commits.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | The description now says "Part of #16189" instead of closing the issue, and a screenshot is included. |
| ⚠️  | The author says the commit message was updated, but the head commit is unchanged, so the commit itself may still say "Fixes". |
| ❌  | The fixture is still not captured from a real Jira instance. The description says it was "constructed following Atlassian's API specification", which the fixture guidelines don't allow. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to replace the fixture with a payload captured from a real Jira instance.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the updates, @huriazahra! The fixture still needs to be a payload captured from a real Jira instance (for example with webhook.site), not one built from the API docs. See the [fixture guidelines](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/webhooks/incoming-webhooks-walkthrough.html#fixture-guidelines), and please also push the commit message change, since the commit looks unchanged.
```
